output.content: {requirements_reuben} walked the team through the current workflow for linking risk assessments to acceptance criteria. He pointed out that there is no automated trigger connecting these two steps. Today, a person manually checks the risk assessment document after it is finalized. They then open the acceptance criteria list and type in the corresponding values by hand. This happens whenever a new model version is prepared for deployment. There are no scripts or workflow events that detect when a risk assessment is complete and update the criteria automatically. The process relies entirely on human memory and manual data entry to keep the two documents synchronized.
output.reclassify_reason: The text objectively describes the current manual workflow and the absence of automated triggers without expressing any wishes, refusals, or stated trade-offs.
